title: A Request for a Meeting
text:
Dear Ms. Garcia,

I am writing to ask about a meeting next week. I need to discuss the new project with you. The meeting can take place in your office. I think it will take about one hour.

Please let me know which day is good for you. I am free on Monday and Wednesday afternoon. You can send your answer to my email address. Thank you very much for your help.

questions.text: What does the writer need to discuss?
Which days is the writer free?
What does the writer probably want?
How does the writer probably feel about the meeting?

vocabulary.definition: an event where people come together to discuss something
to talk about something with another person
a planned piece of work with a clear goal
not busy and able to do something at a certain time

paragraph_translations: Estimada señora García, le escribo para preguntar por una reunión la próxima semana. Necesito hablar con usted sobre el nuevo proyecto. La reunión puede tener lugar en su oficina. Creo que durará aproximadamente una hora.
Por favor, indíqueme qué día le conviene. Estoy libre los lunes y los miércoles por la tarde. Puede enviar su respuesta a mi dirección de correo electrónico. Muchas gracias por su ayuda.
